title: Zustand
description: A small, fast, and scalable state management solution for React.

data.text: Zustand is a lightweight state management library for React inspired by Redux and Recoil but with a much simpler API. It uses hooks under the hood and requires minimal boilerplate.

data.title: Creating a Store
data.content: Create a bear store with increment and decrement actions.

data.title: Minimal Boilerplate
data.text: Zustand stores are just functions — no providers, reducers, or action types required.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Zustand uses React hooks for state access
Middleware support for persistence, devtools, and more
data.takeaway: Zustand is the simplest way to add global state to a React application.
